# Tibia Atlas

> Bilingual (Spanish & English) atlas of Tibia — the MMORPG by CipSoft. At its heart is an interactive world map with every creature's spawns floor by floor and routes between cities, plus a daily wordle, a bestiary and the documented lore of Tibia. Content separates canon from interpretation and cites every source with editorial discipline. Fan project; lore is documented, never invented. Not affiliated with CipSoft.

Each article is structured as: Overview, Canon (only what official sources support), Interpretations, Theories, Related Entities and Sources. Content is available in Spanish (`?lang=es`, default) and English (`?lang=en`).

## Explore

- [Bestiary (creatures)](https://tibiaatlas.com/browse/creature): every documented Tibia creature with stats and lore
- [Characters](https://tibiaatlas.com/browse/character): notable NPCs and figures of Tibian history
- [Cities](https://tibiaatlas.com/browse/city): the cities of Tibia
- [Organizations](https://tibiaatlas.com/browse/organization): factions, guilds and orders
- [Quests](https://tibiaatlas.com/quests): quests grouped by recommended level
- [Items](https://tibiaatlas.com/items): the full item catalogue with stats
- [Map](https://tibiaatlas.com/map): interactive map with creature spawn points
- [Library](https://tibiaatlas.com/history): every readable in-game book, transcribed
- [Timeline](https://tibiaatlas.com/timeline): the complete history of the world and the game
